title: markdown 利用ガイド
description: 標準ライブラリだけで動く Markdown ユーティリティ（読み書き・目次・HTML↔Markdown）。

blocks.text: 1 ファイルを置くだけで動きます（pip 不要）。
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myon-bioinformatics/markdown/main/markdown.py

blocks.title: 📑 目次
blocks.text: 見出しから目次を作ります。

$ python markdown.py toc README.md
- [markdown](#markdown)
  - [GitHub About（推奨）](#github-about推奨)
  - [Purpose](#purpose)
  - [Layout](#layout)
  - [Optional Gradio-only nano environment](#optional-gradio-only-nano-environment)
…

blocks.title: 🔁 Markdown → HTML
blocks.text: ファイルの代わりに - で標準入力を読みます。

$ echo '# hi' | python markdown.py to-html -

hi

blocks.title: 🔎 構成の一覧
blocks.text: 見出し・リンクなどを JSON で出します。

blocks.title: ↩️ HTML → Markdown
blocks.text: HTML を Markdown に戻します。

$ echo '

hi

text

' | python markdown.py to-markdown - # hi text

$ python -c 'import markdown; print(markdown.markdown_to_html("# hi"))'

hi

blocks.title: CSV を Markdown の表にする

blocks.text:
import markdown as md

csv_text = "name,score\nA,3\nB,5\n"
print(md.csv_to_markdown_table(csv_text))

blocks.title: 入力文書の特定セクションだけ抜き出す

blocks.text:
import markdown as md

source = "# Title
## Setup
Install the package.
## Usage
Run it.
"
print(md.extract_section(source, "Setup"))

blocks.title: 既存の LLM 出力をログ用に短くする
blocks.text: モデル呼び出しは不要です。個人情報の伏せ字処理ではありません。

import markdown as md

text = "<think>draft</think>\n# Result\nReady."
print(md.compact_llm_output(text, max_code_lines=10))

books.label: ⚡ そのまま
books.intro: 📋 コピーして手元で試し、結果を記録できます。🤖 の手順は、Pages の公開で実際に動かした結果も載ります。

blocks.title: 💬 チャット画面で表・コード・箇条書き
blocks.text: Gradio の模擬チャットで、返事を markdown.py で組んで表示します（PC 幅とスマホ幅）。最後に 🩺 リポジトリ診断。

blocks.alt: markdown.py chat UI demo rendering a table, code and a list, then the repository diagnostics page

blocks.text: markdown.py が公開する関数・型・定数の一覧です。CLI から呼べる操作は「機能一覧」にあり、ここにある操作は Python の import markdown から利用します。

blocks.title: ファイル・検査
blocks.text: 読み書きと、コード例の検証。doctest は信頼できる文書にのみ使います。

save_markdown — Save Markdown content to a file.
read_markdown — Read a Markdown file and optionally count heading # markers.
run_markdown_doctest — Run Python doctest prompts found in fenced Markdown code blocks.

blocks.title: 構造・抽出
blocks.text: 分析や目次作成では元のファイルを書き換えません。

extract_sections — List ATX headings (level + title), without their body text.
split_sections — Split content into heading-delimited sections, each with its body text.
extract_links — Extract inline, reference-style, angle-autolink and HTML links (not bare images).
extract_images — Extract Markdown and HTML images (not those shown inside code).
extract_code_blocks — Extract fenced code blocks (backticks or tildes).
extract_raw_html — Best-effort list of raw HTML tags found in the document.
extract_urls — Collect unique URLs from links, images, autolinks, and bare URLs.
extract_data_uris — List well-formed literal data URIs without decoding their payloads.
slugify — Convert supported inline heading text to a GitHub-style anchor slug.
table_of_contents — Generate a Markdown bullet list from live top-level ATX headings.
extract_section — Return one ATX heading section, including nested child headings.
strip_prose_keep_structure — Keep Markdown structure while dropping ordinary prose lines.
minify_markdown — Apply conservative physical Markdown minification.
safe_truncate — Truncate to max_chars while closing an open fenced code block.
inventory — Summarize common Markdown constructs present in content.

blocks.title: HTML・DOM・リンク・画像
blocks.text: HTML↔Markdown は対応範囲を絞った変換です。完全な CommonMark やブラウザ DOM ではありません。

make_link — Build a Markdown inline link. make_image — Build a Markdown image. html_image_to_markdown — Convert an tag (or HTML snippet containing one) to Markdown. markdown_image_to_html — Convert a Markdown image (or image URL string) to an tag. html_link_to_markdown — Convert an ... tag to a Markdown link. markdown_link_to_html — Convert a Markdown inline link to an tag. html_to_markdown — Conservatively convert common HTML tags to Markdown. markdown_to_html — Conservatively convert a Markdown *subset* to HTML. markdown_to_web_ui_v1 — Render Markdown inside the stable web-ui HTML contract v1 surface. HtmlNode — Small normalized HTML tree node; not a browser DOM implementation. parse_html_dom — Parse HTML into a small sanitized in-memory tree. html_text_content — Return decoded descendant text from a lightweight DOM node. find_html_text — Return textContent-like decoded text for the first matching safe element. dom_to_html — Serialize a lightweight DOM tree to sanitized HTML. dom_to_markdown — Convert a lightweight DOM tree to normalized Markdown. markdown_to_dom — Convert the repository supported Markdown subset to HtmlNode. markdown_to_kramdown — Rewrite a Markdown subset into Kramdown-leaning Markdown. kramdown_to_markdown — Strip the supported IAL subset back toward plain Markdown. ial — Build a Kramdown Inline Attribute List line. with_attributes — Append a block IAL after block_md. alert_stylesheet — Return compact CSS for .markdown-alert HTML from markdown_to_html. default_stylesheet — Return compact CSS for markdown_to_html output, including alerts. is_probably_url — Return True if value looks like an http(s) URL.

blocks.title: Markdown の組み立て
blocks.text: 見出しや箇条書き、表、コードなどの部品を作ります。

heading — Build an ATX heading (level is clamped to 1-6).
bold — Wrap text in **bold** markers.
italic — Wrap text in *italic* markers.
strikethrough — Wrap text in ~~strikethrough~~ markers.
blockquote — Prefix every line of text with >  to form a blockquote.
alert — Build a site-flavored Markdown alert / callout / note block.
horizontal_rule — Return a thematic break (---).
bullet_list — Build an unordered (-) list from an iterable of strings.
numbered_list — Build an ordered (1.) list from an iterable of strings.
task_item — Build one GFM task-list line (- [ ] text / - [x] text).
task_list — Build a GFM task list from strings or (text, checked) pairs.
details — Build a collapsible section using Zenn's :::details form.
footnote_ref — Build an inline footnote reference ([^id]).
footnote — Build a footnote definition line ([^id]: text).
code_block — Wrap code in a fenced code block, optionally tagged with lang.
key_value_table — Render a mapping as a two-column Markdown table via table.
section — Join a heading with a sequence of pre-rendered Markdown blocks.
inline_code — Wrap text in single backticks for inline code.
json_block — Serialize obj as JSON and wrap it in a JSON fenced code block.
status_line — Build a one-line status message, prefixed with a checkmark or warning.
wrap_section — Wrap content in HTML-comment markers so tools/LLMs can find section boundaries.
md_table — *args version of table — pass values directly, no list needed.
md_kv — *args version of key_value_table — pass key, value pairs or dicts.

blocks.title: 図とグラフ
blocks.text: Mermaid や DOT のソースを生成します。図そのものの描画はしません。

mermaid_block — Wrap opaque Mermaid source in a safe mermaid fenced block.
extract_mermaid_blocks — Return Mermaid fenced-block sources in document order.
markdown_headings_to_mermaid_mindmap — Generate deterministic Mermaid mindmap source from live ATX headings.
markdown_tasks_to_mermaid_flowchart — Generate Mermaid flowchart source from narrow GFM task dependencies.
python_to_mermaid_class_diagram — Generate Mermaid classDiagram source from Python class structure.
markdown_links_to_dot — Generate a deterministic DOT link graph grouped by current heading.

blocks.title: Python・環境・メール
blocks.text: API や実行環境を文書化します。メールは組み立てるだけで送信しません。

inspect_to_markdown — Generate a small API reference for an already-provided Python object.
argparse_to_markdown — Generate deterministic CLI reference Markdown from an ArgumentParser.
distribution_to_markdown — Generate package metadata Markdown for an installed distribution.
calendar_to_markdown — Render one month as a heading plus a GFM table of day numbers.
platform_to_markdown — Summarize the running interpreter/OS as a two-column Markdown table.
email_to_markdown — Render an RFC 5322 / MIME message as Markdown without side effects.
markdown_to_email — Build (never send) a multipart/alternative email from Markdown.
markdown_to_man — Render the Markdown lite subset as a man(7) troff page (one-way).

blocks.title: 会話と文書形式
blocks.text: 各文書形式の対応範囲内で変換します。

markdown_to_slack_mrkdwn — Convert the Markdown lite subset to Slack mrkdwn text.
slack_mrkdwn_to_markdown — Convert Slack mrkdwn text to canonical Markdown.
chat_messages_to_markdown — Render [{"role": ..., "content": ...}] as ## Role sections.
markdown_to_chat_messages — Parse ## System / ## User / ## Assistant ... sections.
markdown_to_org — Convert the Markdown lite subset to Org-mode.
org_to_markdown — Convert Org-mode to canonical Markdown (the markdown_to_org subset).
markdown_to_mediawiki — Convert the Markdown lite subset to MediaWiki markup.
mediawiki_to_markdown — Convert MediaWiki markup to canonical Markdown (narrow contract).
markdown_to_jira — Convert the Markdown lite subset to Jira wiki markup.
jira_to_markdown — Convert Jira wiki markup to canonical Markdown (narrow contract).

blocks.title: 表・CSV・設定データ
blocks.text: 表、JSON、INI、TOML、dotenv を扱います。形式により対応範囲は異なります。

table — Build a Markdown (GFM-style) table.
aligned_table — Build a pipe table aligned by display width, including CJK cells.
markdown_table_to_rows — Read the first live GFM pipe table as (headers, rows).
markdown_table_to_records — Read the first GFM pipe table as dictionaries keyed by its headers.
csv_to_markdown_table — Convert CSV text to a GFM pipe table using the first row as headers.
markdown_table_to_csv — Convert the first live GFM pipe table to RFC-style CSV text.
markdown_table_statistics — Return a small, non-mutating summary of the first Markdown table.
json_to_markdown — Wrap JSON data as a Markdown document without performing I/O.
markdown_to_json — Read the first JSON fence emitted by json_to_markdown.
structured_to_markdown — Render JSON-compatible Python data as a canonical typed Markdown table.
markdown_to_structured — Restore data emitted by structured_to_markdown.
ini_to_markdown — Convert INI to canonical structured Markdown.
markdown_to_ini — Convert canonical structured Markdown to deterministic INI text.
toml_to_markdown — Convert TOML to canonical structured Markdown.
toml_reader — Which TOML reader toml_to_markdown uses: "tomllib", "node" or None.
markdown_to_toml — Convert canonical structured Markdown to deterministic TOML text.
dotenv_to_markdown — Convert a narrow dotenv subset to canonical structured Markdown.
pixiv_to_markdown — Convert pixiv's source markup (star headings, wiki links, row-header tables, media) to Markdown.
markdown_to_dotenv — Convert canonical structured Markdown to deterministic dotenv text.

blocks.title: ディレクトリ・DB・ノートブック
blocks.text: scaffold_from_markdown はファイルシステムに書き込みます。Redis／SQL の変換は接続・実行しません。

markdown_to_directory_tree — Parse a nested Markdown bullet list into a directory tree mapping.
directory_tree_to_markdown — Render a directory tree mapping as a canonical nested Markdown list.
directory_to_markdown — Describe an existing directory as a canonical nested Markdown list.
tree_text_to_markdown — Convert tree-command style text into a canonical Markdown list.
markdown_to_tree_text — Render a Markdown directory list as tree-command style text.
scaffold_from_markdown — Create the directories and empty files described by a Markdown list.
redis_snapshot_to_markdown — Document an already obtained Redis/RedisJSON snapshot without connecting.
sql_ddl_to_markdown — Document a supplied SQL DDL snapshot without parsing or executing it.
markdown_to_sql_ddl — Return the first SQL snapshot without validating or executing it.
markdown_to_ipynb — Make a minimal nbformat-4 JSON notebook from Markdown and Python fences.
ipynb_to_markdown — Render Markdown and code cell sources from a minimal nbformat notebook.
markdown_to_py_percent — Convert Markdown/Python fences to a narrow Jupytext py:percent form.
py_percent_to_markdown — Convert the canonical narrow py:percent subset back to Markdown.

blocks.title: LLM 出力と識別子
blocks.text: モデルを呼ばずに既存の出力を整理します。

split_reasoning — Split reasoning-model output into its answer and reasoning blocks.
compact_llm_output — Deterministically compress LLM output for logs and test assertions.
llm_output_digest — Summarize LLM output as a small JSON-able dict for logs and assertions.
extract_identifiers — Find IDs worth referencing instead of embedding whole content.

blocks.title: 公開データ
blocks.text: 対応範囲や用途別の値を参照できます。

ALERT_FLAVORS — 対応するアラートの記法。
GITHUB_ALERT_KINDS — GitHub 形式で使えるアラート種別。
QIITA_NOTE_KINDS — Qiita 形式で使えるノート種別。
ZENN_MESSAGE_KINDS — Zenn 形式で使えるメッセージ種別。
CHAT_ROLES — 会話変換が扱うロール。
SUPPORTED — 対応する記法と変換の範囲。
UNSUPPORTED — 非対応の記法と変換の範囲。
